turns.question: What was our total revenue over 1 and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: Revenue (EUR) over 1 and 2 October 2026 (2026-10-01 to 2026-10-02) was 1,850.34 EUR. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.question: And broken down by customer country, how much of it came from Germany?
turns.answer: Of that revenue over 1 and 2 October 2026, customers in Germany (DE) accounted for 410.75 EUR (the others: TR 586.25, FR 308.79, NL 268.25, US 167.00, GB 109.30 EUR). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
